department: Department of Biochemistry and Medical Genetics

deadline.value: International applicants: January 15 for Fall (September) entry (Winter March 30, Summer September 1).
deadline.quote: International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 15 Winter (January) March 30 Summer (May) September 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must interview with a Biochemistry and Medical Genetics faculty member and get confirmation they will accept you before applying.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor support: Confirm support from a potential supervisor before applying. | You must interview (by email or virtually) with a potential supervisor before applying. Obtain confirmation that the supervisor will accept you

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

entry_route.value: A thesis-based master's (at least two years) in biochemistry, genetics or a related field is required; strong first-year master's students may transfer.
entry_route.quote: Educational background: A thesis-based master’s degree (at least two years long) or an equivalent degree in biochemistry, genetics, or a closely related field.

notes: Other biomedical PhDs in the Rady Faculty of Health Sciences: Immunology, Medical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases, Pharmacology and Therapeutics, Physiology and Pathophysiology, Human Anatomy and Cell Science. GPA 3.5 on a 4.5 scale required.
name: Biochemistry and Medical Genetics (PhD)
